color.note: Brand hues are sampled from the supplied logo PNGs (leaf, coral and amber are the flat fills of the horizontal lockup; sun and navy are the mid-tones of the glossy stacked mark). In light, ink, ink-muted and border are derived from the navy. The dark theme is a dark slate with only a slight blue hint, tuned at the owner's request (a deep navy was too blue, neutral charcoal too grey); it is not in the logo files. The four brand fills keep the same value in both themes; navy lightens in dark so it stays legible as text.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Brand green: the left figure of the mark and the green letters of the horizontal lockup. Large fills, marks and accents on surface and plate in both themes (5.1:1 on dark plate). Never text on the light surface (2.4:1); put on-leaf on it.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Brand yellow: the right figure of the mark. Fills and highlights; never text or a thin line on the light surface. Put on-sun on it.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Brand amber: the orange letters of the horizontal lockup. Fills and accents; put on-amber on it. Not for text on the light surface.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Brand coral: the bottom figure of the mark and the red-orange letters of the horizontal lockup. Fills, marks and large accents: 3.5:1 on light surface, 3.2:1 on light plate, 4.2:1 on dark surface, 3.4:1 on dark plate. Text on it uses on-coral.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand blue (#1a5995 in light: the Hathmaluwa wordmark in the stacked lockup; lightened in dark). Headings, links and the focus ring on surface and plate: 7.2:1 and 6.5:1 in light, 6.9:1 and 5.6:1 in dark. Fill it with on-navy text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface and plate: 17.7:1 and 15.8:1 in light, 13.5:1 and 10.9:1 in dark. Derived from the navy in light; cool near-white in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and helper copy on surface and plate: 6.8:1 and 6.0:1 in light, 8.3:1 and 6.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in both themes (white in light, dark slate with a slight blue hint in dark).

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Raised or tinted panels: the grey plate behind the horizontal lockup in light, a slightly lighter slate in dark. Ink, ink-muted and navy read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and controls, and dividers that carry meaning: 3.5:1 on light surface and 3.2:1 on light plate, 5.0:1 on dark surface and 4.1:1 on dark plate.

tokens.name: on-leaf
tokens.usage: Text and icons on leaf fills: 7.4:1 (light), 7.3:1 (dark). Dark ink in both themes.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sun fills: 12:1 in both themes. Dark ink in both themes.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on amber fills: 7.6:1 in both themes. Dark ink in both themes.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text and icons on coral fills: 5.0:1 in both themes. Dark ink in both themes; white on coral is 3.5:1 and only passes for 24px+ text.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy fills: white on #1a5995 is 7.2:1 in light; dark slate on the lightened navy is 6.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: logo-ground
tokens.usage: The ground under the supplied logo PNGs. Both logos are made for white: in the dark theme set them on a logo-ground panel (radius-md, space-3 padding), never straight on surface.

type.note: No font files were supplied and none exist yet. Display text uses a serif system stack, echoing the bold serif of the Latin wordmark; UI and body text use a sans system stack that falls back to a Sinhala-capable face. Replace these stacks when the brand picks fonts.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Sinhala", "Sinhala MN", sans-serif

styles.name: display
